descripcion_geo: Northwest region of Asia Minor; includes Troas (Troas), where Paul had the vision of the Macedonian.

historias.titulo: Paul passes through Mysia and goes down to Troad
historias.descripcion: Crossing Mysia, Paul and his companions descend to Troad where they will receive the vision of the Macedonian.

historias.titulo: Troad: port of Mysia and crossing to Europe
historias.descripcion: From Troad (a coastal city in Mysia), Paul sets sail for Macedonia in response to the night vision.

historias.titulo: Paul meets with the disciples in Troad
historias.descripcion: On the third voyage, Paul spends a week in Troad of Mysia; There he resurrects Eutychus who fell asleep.

personajes.descripcion: He passed through Mysia on his way to Troad and the vision of the Macedonian.
Possibly joined Paul at Troad of Mysia; the 'we' of Acts begins here.
He fell asleep at a window during Paul's long speech; Paul resurrected him.

contexto_religioso.contexto_lugar: Mysia: relevant region in the world of the NT.

mitos.nombre: Troad: the crossing from Asia to Europe

cristianismo.descripcion: The vision of the Macedonian in Troad of Mysia was the decisive moment when the gospel jumped from Asia to Europe.
cristianismo.significado_teologico: The vision of the Macedonian in Troad of Mysia was the decisive moment when the gospel jumped from Asia to Europe.
